- 15 min: live demo of Redwood Private + routing/cost controls
- 10 min: Q&A (SLA/contracting/next steps)

High priority for the deck: show predictable latency across dedicated vs private, and the audit/compliance story for procurement. If your CTO prefers a different focus, we can pivot.

A few time windows we can offer (all PT):
- Tue 2026-04-28: 10:00–10:40 or 15:00–15:40
- Wed 2026-04-29: 11:00–11:40 or 16:00–16:40

If those don't work, please send a couple of slots and I’ll coordinate. I’ve attached the short agenda and the runbook we’ll follow.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Subject: Confirmed: Wed Apr 29 11:00 PT — Redwood x Helix exec demo (35 min)

Hi Dana — thanks for confirming. Calendar invite attached; we have Wed Apr 29, 11:00–11:35 PT as the primary slot and Thu Apr 30, 13:00–13:35 PT held as a fallback.

Attachments included: redwood-demo-agenda-v1.pdf, runbook-30min-demo.xlsx, poc-setup-checklist.txt

Per procurement’s ask, brief on data handling and audit logs:
- Data in transit is TLS 1.3; stored model artifacts and logs can be encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
- Audit logs include per-request metadata (timestamp, model id, route, bytes processed) and are retained per-customer retention policy — default 90 days, configurable up to 7 years on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Access controls: RBAC + SSO (SAML/OIDC) and optional split custody keys for deploy-time secrets.
- We support SOC 2 Type II evidence and can provide sample retention configs for your legal review.

Links: calendly (for changes) https://calendly.com/tessa-morgan/30min — HubSpot deal https://hubspot.com/deals/HLX-2026-04-17 — shared notes https://docs.redwood.ai/shared/Helix-POC-Notes

If procurement wants any additional artifacts for legal before the meeting, let me know and Rishi will share them. See you Wed.

—Tessa
